# Task: Build Enterprise MLOps Platform — Detailed Build (12-VM single-cloud)

You are working in a git worktree for the repo "mlops-platform-spec-detailed". Read the authoritative spec file in this directory: `mlops-platform-spec-detailed.md` and implement it EXACTLY. It is implementation-ready (file-level layout, IP plan, concrete ML/API/monitoring contracts).

On each iteration: first inspect current repo state (git status, existing files). Continue from where you left off. Do not stop until everything below exists and is correct. Work ONLY inside this directory. Commit progress with `git add -A && git commit -m "..."` on branch agent/backend-agent.

## Repo layout (per spec §3, exact tree)
- `terraform/`: main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, backend.tf, terraform.tfvars.example, modules/{network,security-groups,compute} with REAL resources. Default provider: Google Cloud Platform (overridable). Provision 12 VMs per the spec §2 IP plan: ctrl-node 10.0.2.10, git-cicd .11, k8s-cp .20, k8s-wk1 .21, k8s-wk2 .22, mlflow .30, fastapi .31, postgres .40, prometheus .50, grafana .51, training-env .60, testing-env .61. Security groups per §2: sg-mgmt (22 from admin IP), sg-internal (all internal traffic), sg-k8s (6443/2379-2380/10250-10259/NodePort internal), sg-public (80/443 from internet).
- `ansible/`: ansible.cfg, inventory/hosts.ini, group_vars/{all,k8s,mlflow}.yml, site.yml, playbooks/01-common.yml through 07-monitoring.yml, roles/{common,docker,k8s-common,k8s-control-plane,k8s-worker,mlflow,postgresql,cicd,prometheus,node_exporter,grafana} with real tasks/main.yml + handlers.
- `docker/`: fastapi/{Dockerfile,.dockerignore}, mlflow/Dockerfile, training/Dockerfile.
- `kubernetes/`: namespace.yml (mlops), fastapi/{deployment.yml,service.yml,configmap.yml (MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI, MODEL_NAME, MODEL_STAGE),secret.yml (DB creds),ingress.yml}, hpa.yml.
- `ml/`: data/raw (generate realistic synthetic Telco churn CSV ~7000 rows via a python script you write and run; keep the script), data/processed, notebooks/01-eda.ipynb (valid JSON), training/{train.py,preprocess.py,features.py,config.yml}, evaluation/evaluate.py (compare against current Production model, compute F1/ROC-AUC), models/.gitkeep. train.py: RandomForest, log params+metrics to MLflow, register "churn-model", transition to Staging.
- `api/`: main.py, requirements.txt, app/{__init__.py, model_loader.py (load via mlflow.pyfunc.load_model("models:/churn-model/Production") on startup), schemas.py, routers/{predict.py,health.py}, db.py (SQLAlchemy), metrics.py (prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator)}. Endpoints: POST /predict, GET /health (DB + model loaded), GET /model-info. Log every prediction to Postgres predictions table (spec §6/§7: id, input_payload JSONB, prediction, probability, model_name, model_version, model_stage, latency_ms, created_at).
- `monitoring/`: prometheus/{prometheus.yml,alert.rules.yml} (alert rules: FastAPIHighErrorRate 5xx>5% over 5m, FastAPIHighLatency p95>500ms over 5m, PredictionVolumeDrop, NoModelLoaded), grafana/dashboards/{node-exporter.json,kubernetes-cluster.json,fastapi-requests.json,model-performance.json}.
- `scripts/`: bootstrap.sh (wraps terraform init+apply, inventory generation, ansible-playbook), generate-inventory.py, train-and-register.sh, smoke-test.sh (POST /predict with a sample payload).
- `cicd/`: Jenkinsfile, stages/{train.sh,test.sh,build.sh,deploy.sh} (manual approval promotion gate per spec §9).
- `README.md`, `Makefile`, `.gitignore`.
- Leave `docs/` directory present (a docs agent fills architecture.md, deployment-guide.md, api-documentation.md, etc. later). Do NOT write test files (QA agent handles tests/).

## Validation
- `python3 -m py_compile` on every .py file.
- If deps installable (`pip install scikit-learn pandas mlflow --quiet`), run the training script end-to-end and confirm the model registers in MLflow. Fix errors until it works. Otherwise ensure code correctness.

## Completion
When the ENTIRE repository above is built, validated, and committed on branch agent/backend-agent, output exactly:
<promise>BUILD_COMPLETE</promise>
Do not output that tag before everything is genuinely done.
